name: policy-reinstate
description: Flow 5. VOIDED -> ACTIVE with a fresh void_due_date, and the rescheduler of ALL THREE reinstatement-affected timers per contract artefact 5: policy-void:<policyId>, renewal-generate:<policyId> (T-100) and renewal-dispatch:<policyId> (T-90). Each target subject is resolved DYNAMICALLY at run time from the published workflow list by name and the run refuses to schedule any of them if a lookup fails, because scheduleFlow does not validate its subject and a typo'd one returns 200 and produces a live timer that fires into nothing. Draft subjects are excluded from the match. It re-stamps all three returned topics in one record update (ASSERT-2b), asserts they are distinct and non-empty first (ASSERT-1b), and honours artefact 5's past-trigger_on rule: a policy inside its last 100 days gets an empty string for the renewal topics rather than a timer booked in the past. It also restores voidance_notice_state/sent_at and auto_renewal_eligible, without which a reinstated policy could never be voided or renewed again. The reinstatement justification is stamped onto policy_config's void_override_reason/by/at because no audit trail on a record edit exists anywhere on the platform. Gateway trigger. Payload: {policy_id, justification, reinstated_by}.
